result.instructions: Tools for Amberflo, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Amberflo data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run amberflo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run amberflo_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run amberflo_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. amberflo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: amberflo_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List all customers registered in your Amberflo account (id, name, email, traits, enabled). Good first call to discover customer ids. API: GET /customers/.

tools.name: amberflo_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by its Amberflo customerId. API: GET /customers/?customerId=<id>.

tools.name: amberflo_list_meters
tools.title: List meters
tools.description: List all meter definitions in your account (id, meterApiName, label, meterType, aggregation, etc.). Use meterApiName values here as inputs to usage tools. API: GET /meters.

tools.name: amberflo_get_usage
tools.title: Query usage for a meter
tools.description: Query aggregated usage for a single meter over a time range, optionally grouped/filtered. API: POST /usage/.

aggregation.description: Aggregation function: SUM | COUNT | MIN | MAX.

time_grouping_interval.description: Bucket size: HOUR | DAY | WEEK | MONTH.

end_time_in_seconds.description: Range end, unix epoch seconds. Defaults to now if omitted.

group_by.description: Dimension names to group results by, e.g. ["customerId"].

filter.description: Dimension filter: map of dimension name -> allowed values.

take_limit.description: Return only the top N groups.

tools.name: amberflo_get_all_usage
tools.title: Get all usage
tools.description: Get total usage across all meters over a time range, optionally grouped by customer or filtered to one customer. API: GET /usage/all.

end_time_in_seconds.description: Range end, unix epoch seconds. Defaults to now if omitted.

time_grouping_interval.description: Bucket size: HOUR | DAY | WEEK | MONTH.

group_by_customer_id.description: When true, group results by customer (sends groupBy=customerId).

filter_by_customer_id.description: Restrict results to a single customerId.

tools.name: amberflo_explain_usage
tools.title: Explain usage
tools.description: Explain/drill into the raw meter events behind a meter's usage over a time range — useful to debug why a number looks off. API: POST /usage/explain.

end_time_in_seconds.description: Range end, unix epoch seconds. Defaults to now if omitted.

take_limit.description: Return only the top N records.

group_by.description: Dimension names to group by, e.g. ["customerId"].

filter.description: Dimension filter: map of dimension name -> allowed values.

aggregation.description: Aggregation function: SUM | COUNT | MIN | MAX.

tools.name: amberflo_get_customer_plan
tools.title: Get customer plan
tools.description: Get a customer's LATEST assigned product plan (pricing). API: GET /payments/pricing/amberflo/customer-pricing?CustomerId=<id>.

tools.name: amberflo_list_customer_plan_history
tools.title: List customer plan history
tools.description: List the full history of product plans assigned to a customer over time. API: GET /payments/pricing/amberflo/customer-pricing/list?CustomerId=<id>.

tools.name: amberflo_list_customer_invoices
tools.title: List customer invoices
tools.description: List all invoices for a customer (optionally for a specific product), with payment status. API: GET /payments/billing/customer-product-invoice/all.

tools.name: amberflo_get_customer_invoice
tools.title: Get customer invoice
tools.description: Get a single customer invoice: the CURRENT open invoice (latest=true, default) or a SPECIFIC past invoice by product_plan_id + year + month + day. API: GET /payments/billing/customer-product-invoice.

latest.description: Fetch the current open invoice. Default true. Ignored when a specific invoice is addressed.

product_plan_id.description: Product plan id of a specific past invoice (with year/month/day).

year.description: Year of a specific past invoice.

month.description: Month (1-12) of a specific past invoice.

day.description: Day of month of a specific past invoice.

tools.name: amberflo_list_prepaid_orders
tools.title: List prepaid orders
tools.description: List a customer's active prepaid credit orders for a product. API: GET /payments/pricing/amberflo/customer-prepaid/list?CustomerId=<id>&ProductId=<pid>.

tools.name: amberflo_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create/register a new customer in Amberflo (id + name required; optional email, enabled flag, and traits). Optionally auto-create the customer in Stripe. API: POST /customers/.

customer_id.description: Unique customerId to assign (your identifier for the customer).

create_in_stripe.description: When true, also auto-create this customer in Stripe (adds ?autoCreateCustomerInStripe=true).

tools.name: amberflo_assign_customer_plan
tools.title: Assign customer plan
tools.description: WRITE: assign/attach a pricing product plan to a customer — this changes what the customer is billed. API: POST /payments/pricing/amberflo/customer-pricing.

customer_id.description: The Amberflo customerId to assign the plan to.

product_plan_id.description: The productPlanId of the plan to assign.

product_id.description: Product id the plan belongs to.

start_time_in_seconds.description: When the plan takes effect, unix epoch seconds.

end_time_in_seconds.description: When the plan ends, unix epoch seconds.

tools.name: amberflo_ingest_usage
tools.title: Ingest usage event
tools.description: WRITE: record/ingest a single usage meter event (writes billable usage data) to the Amberflo ingestion host. API: POST /ingest/ on the ingest base URL.

meter_api_name.description: The meterApiName this event is for.

meter_value.description: The numeric value of the usage event.

customer_id.description: The customerId this usage belongs to.

dimensions.description: Optional dimensions (key/value string metadata) for the event.

unique_id.description: Optional idempotency/unique id for the event.
